title: Authoritative source map
summary: The current project implementation is oorexx_access_permissions_v0.3.zip. Core authority objects live in AccessPermissions.cls and the Alchemy integration/session composition lives in AlchemyAccessPermissionsAdapter.cls.
invariants: AccessPermissions.cls owns principals, authentication assertions/verifier, Access Control requests/rules/policies/authority, Permission requests/rules/policies/authority, proofs/envelopes, and AccessPermissionsPolicyResolver.
AlchemyAccessPermissionsAdapter.cls owns AlchemyAccessSessionGuard, AlchemyPermissionPolicyAdapter, AlchemyAccessControlledSession, and AlchemyAccessControlledDomain.
Institutional Policy, Security Effect, Crypto, and Alchemy Security Manager remain separate dependencies/authorities.

provenance.claim: README enumerates the principal Access Permissions and Alchemy integration classes in the current project.
Adapter source documents protected-domain composition and the non-bearer Access Control receipt invariant.
